subject.title: feat(android): add safe cron job management

question: After the code blockers are fixed, should maintainers require inspectable Android runtime proof for this cron-management feature, or explicitly accept the current Testbox/build summaries as a proof override?
rationale: The branch adds admin-scoped cron mutation behavior in a mobile UI, and external-PR real-behavior proof is not satisfied by uninspectable summary claims unless a maintainer intentionally accepts that evidence standard.

options.title: Require Inspectable Android Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted emulator or device recording, screenshots with logs, linked artifact, or live output showing run, edit, enable/disable, history, and delete behavior on the reviewed head.

options.title: Accept Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the existing Testbox/build summaries and own the remaining runtime-proof uncertainty after code blockers are fixed.

options.title: Pause Until Live Validation Finishes
options.body: Keep the PR open without landing until the in-progress API 36 validation is attached in an inspectable form.

recommendation.title: Require Inspectable Android Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted emulator or device recording, screenshots with logs, linked artifact, or live output showing run, edit, enable/disable, history, and delete behavior on the reviewed head.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest Android and cron history signal and authored the canonical replacement branch.
